text: Ugh... Working late again. And on a Friday no less!
I've just gotta get this bug sorted, then I can go home and get some much needed sleep.
This is so unfair. Everyone else left hours ago, even my boss.
I also haven't eaten since noon...
But there's no way around it, I have to get this code submitted tonight or I'll risk getting fired.
Man, these app breaking bugs keep cropping up more and more. It's almost like we should focus on fixing tech debt instead of shoving in "Exciting New Features".
Yeah, right. Like that'll ever happen.
What the hell was that?!
I guess it could just be the building settling... Weird.
I just wanna get this done and go home.
Boss: Hey Finley, I just wanted to touch base. Where are we at on that bug fix?
Ha! "We". As if she's here working on this crap with me.
You: Hey Karen! I should be finished up within the hour. Sorry for the delay!
Boss: Alright, just let me know when you're finished. It's critical that we get this fix deployed tonight.
You: Can do!

Synergy Metrics

Moving the needle daily.
What the...?! There's that strange sound again.
You know, it's probably just one of my co-workers playing a prank on me. Everyone knows I'm here late again.
Very funny, knock it off! I'm just trying to finish my code so I can leave this damn desk.
Assholes.
Spouse: Hey Fin, I thought you'd be home already. Where are you?
You: Sorry, I forgot to text you. I'm working late again. :/
Spouse: Again?! This is getting ridiculous. It's Friday night.
You: I know, but my boss is counting on me to get this bug fixed today. Should be home in a bit.
Spouse: You said that last time... You haven't been sleeping. I'm worried about your mental health.
You: I promise I'll get some sleep this weekend. I just really have to get this done.
Spouse: Ugh. Fine. Just text me when you're leaving the office.
My partner is right. I have been working the graveyard shift a lot lately.
Wait. Is it really even the graveyard shift if I've been here since 9AM?
Oh boy... I just realized how tired I am. Not sure how long I can keep burning the midnight oil.
I'll just make a quick cup of coffee and get back to it.
Alright, now back to this damn bug.

Okay, what the actual hell is happening?!...
Now that I think about it...
This can't be my co-workers messing with me. The whole building is locked up, and I would've heard them use their keycards to come in.
I'm probably just hearing things. I've been running on coffee for days. I just wanna be home man...
But I'm so close to cranking this out.
I can't get fired now. The job market is terrible... And I can't go through 10 rounds of coding interviews.
Just gotta keep drinking this coffee and press on.
